annotations.target_phrase: Lady 3Jane Marie-France Tessier-Ashpool had carved herself a low country flush with the inner surface of Straylight’s hull
annotations.annotation_text: Lady 3Jane's decadent living quarters inside Straylight: an engineered architectural rupture within the spindle's core, displaying the aristocratic indifference of the Tessier-Ashpool clan.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 230.
